text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Kingston Road, City Council approval of this report is required. Scarborough Community Council directed Transportation Services to conduct a review of various safety and operational concerns for road users at the intersection of Kingston Road and Collinsgrove Road. This report provides an overview of the assessments undertaken by Transportation Services.
City Council on April 17 and 18, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (March 15, 2024) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services for information.
